UnpublishAlsoDisablesBooking: Unpublishing returns the event to Draft and automatically disables booking.
PublishDoesNotEnableBooking: Publishing does not enable booking. Enable booking separately to start accepting orders.
DisableBookingDoesNotUnpublish: Disabling booking does not unpublish the event.
EnableBookingRequiresPublished: Booking can only be enabled for a published event that has at least one sellable occurrence.
EventCannotBeCancelledWithOrders: This event already has orders, so it can no longer be cancelled.
CancelEventIsTerminal: Cancelling is final: the event cannot be edited, published or reopened afterwards.
CancelEventDeletesNothing: Nothing is deleted — all occurrences are cancelled, gate access is revoked and booking is disabled.
AcceptingOrdersHelp: Computed by the server: it also checks published status, remaining capacity and the schedule.
OccurrenceEndMustBeAfterStart: The end must be after the start.
OccurrenceMustFitInsideEventDates: The occurrence must fall inside the event display window.
OccurrenceBusinessDateMustBeUnique: Only one occurrence may start on each Riyadh calendar day.
AtLeastOneOccurrenceRequired: At least one occurrence is required.
GatekeeperPhoneNumberMustBeUnique: This phone number is already used by another gatekeeper.
OccurrencesWillBeCancelledDescription: Occurrences you removed from the list are cancelled, not deleted, and can be restored from the schedule tab.
GatekeeperSessionsWillBeInvalidated: All gatekeeper sessions for this event will be signed out and must re-verify by OTP.
RateLimitedRetryAfter: Too many requests. Please try again in {{seconds}} seconds.
MaximumTicketsPerPurchaserHelp: The maximum number of tickets a single purchaser may hold for this event.
EventDisplayWindowDescription: The window the event is shown in. Every occurrence must fall inside it.
AllTimesAreRiyadh: All times are entered and shown in Riyadh time (Asia/Riyadh).
EndDateMustBeAfterStartDate: The end date must be after the start date.
OccurrencesFormDescription: The actual dates attendees are admitted on. One occurrence per Riyadh calendar day, no overlaps.
ScheduleIsAFullReplaceDescription: Any active occurrence you remove from this list will be cancelled when you save.
CancelledOccurrencesHidden: {{count}} cancelled occurrence(s) are not shown here
CancelledOccurrencesHiddenDescription: Cancelled occurrences cannot be re-added through this form. Restore them from the schedule tab instead.
RemoveOccurrenceWillCancel: Remove — this occurrence will be cancelled on save
CapacityDescription: Total tickets available, and how many a single purchaser may hold.
CapacityCannotBeLessThanConsumed: Capacity cannot go below {{consumed}} — that many tickets are already issued.
GatekeepersFormDescription: People who scan tickets at the gate. They sign in with their phone number.
GatekeeperRemovalIsAllOrNothing: Removing a gatekeeper is an all-or-nothing save
GatekeeperRemovalIsAllOrNothingDescripti: The gatekeeper's live session is revoked before the update commits. If revocation fails the whole update is rejected and nothing changes.
GatekeepersLimit: Up to {{max}} gatekeepers, each with a unique phone number.
EventIsCancelledReadOnly: This event is cancelled and is read-only.
ScheduleFrozenByOrders: The schedule is frozen because this event already has orders.
AcceptingOrdersShownInList: Whether the event is accepting orders right now is computed by the server and shown in the events list.
CoveredOccurrencesHelp: The occurrences a newly purchased ticket grants access to.
NoAdmissionProduct: No admission ticket is configured yet.
AreYouSureYouWantToCancelThisOccurrence: Are you sure you want to cancel this occurrence?
CancelOccurrenceCoveredTicketsNote: Cancelling is rejected when an active ticket already covers this occurrence.
AreYouSureYouWantToRestoreThisOccurrence: Are you sure you want to restore this occurrence?
WhyScheduleLocked: Schedule changes are blocked once the first order is placed, or after the event is cancelled.
DeliveryIsNotAdmission: Delivery status only describes the WhatsApp message — it does not mean the attendee was admitted.
TicketTokenIsSensitive: The ticket token is the credential gate scanners accept. Reveal it only when necessary.
FailedDeliveryIsStillValid: A failed delivery does not invalidate the ticket — the attendee can still be admitted.
DeliveryFilterIsOrderLevel: This filters orders having at least one ticket in that state — the order may also contain tickets in other states.
OrdersAreSensitive: This page contains sensitive ticket credentials. Do not share or export it.
InternalDiagnosticsOnly: Internal diagnostics — do not share with the attendee.
